_about: Shared vector for the relay pin (specs/client_custody_mail.md R10): the pin MAC is HMAC-SHA256 under HKDF-SHA256(vault secret as the keyring holds it: PKCS#8, 302e020100300506032b656e04220420 then vault_secret_hex; empty salt; info sealed-vault:pin) over joinery-relay-pin:v1 LF alias_id LF relay identity key; the statement is signed by the relay identity over joinery-relay:seal-target:v1 LF statement. fortress_relay_pull_test.php reproduces it and MailboxFortress.selfCheck() checks the same values in the browser. Test keys only.
